observations.statement: Exact canonicalization under variable renaming is a graph-canonicalization obligation, not ordinary clause sorting; C010 therefore guarantees it only by exhaustive relabeling for at most eight used variables and refuses larger unsupported claims.
Exact-alpha and SAT-label diagnostics are answer-dependent and must remain outside the canonical theta profile used by H078 and H087.
A valid DIMACS parser must preserve empty clauses and validate the header, variable range, clause count, and zero termination; otherwise experiments can silently change the represented formula.

Coordinate permutations and complementations act on bounded squarefree monomial bases through exact invertible integer matrices; this supplies a checkable proof artifact for the algebraic core of H075 without promoting it to PROVED.
Functional bounded-depth substitution and existential projection are distinct resources; any theta-rank preservation argument must state which one it controls.
Exact rational Gram-factor verification is polynomial in the supplied artifact size, but this does not imply that short factors exist or can be found efficiently.
C010 expands the inversion matrix to 40x40 while keeping thirty-two of forty hypotheses inherited from earlier cycles.
C010 records no terminal result because no exact prior statement received a decisive theorem or counterexample; attack pressure is not converted into artificial graveyard growth.
